svg.title: PostgreSQL Column Conversion Flow
svg.desc: Write and read conversion flow for PostGIS, pgvector, and TSTZRANGE column types.
svg.text: Each family keeps the Kotlin API small while the ColumnType owns JDBC wrapping, literals, and dialect-specific SQL.

g.text: Call registerVectorType() once per connection before reading pgvector values.
Parser accepts ISO-8601 and PostgreSQL JDBC timestamps, including fractional seconds.
